source_title: Aamir Khan celebrates first Karwa Chauth with Gauri Spratt after wedding
source_excerpt: Aamir Khan and Gauri Spratt celebrated their first Karwa Chauth together as a married couple on Thursday. The actor attended the annual festive gathering hosted by Sunita Kapoor at her Juhu residence in Mumbai. The occasion brought together several celebrities and members of Bollywood families for the traditional celebration.The couple arrived hand in hand, drawing attention as they entered the venue. Aamir Khan kept his outfit understated with a black-and-blue kurta set. Gauri Spratt, meanwhile, chose a royal blue Banarasi suit. She completed her traditional look with minimal accessories and subtle makeup.Aamir Khan and Gauri Spratt celebrate first Karwa Chauth after weddingThe celebration held special significance for Aamir Khan and Gauri Spratt, as it was their first Karwa Chauth following their marriage. The couple tied the knot on July 5, 2026, in an intimate registered ceremony at the actor's residence in Mumbai's Bandra area.Their appearance at Sunita Kapoor's gathering marked their first participation in the annual festivities as a married couple.Sunita Kapoor hosts annual Karwa Chauth celebrationSunita Kapoor continued her tradition of welcoming members of the film fraternity to her Juhu residence for Karwa Chauth. The gathering attracted several familiar faces from the entertainment industry, including actors, filmmakers and celebrity spouses.Farah Khan, Sonam Kapoor, Shilpa Shetty, Anshula Kapoor, Mira Rajput, Tahira Kashyap, Mini Mathur, Padmini Kolhapure and Neelam Kothari were among those present. Bhavana Pandey, Maheep Kapoor and veteran screenwriter Javed Akhtar also attended the festivities.Sonam Kapoor, Shilpa Shetty and Mira Rajput impress with festive looksSonam Kapoor stood out in a rust-maroon outfit styled with statement earrings and an eye-catching handbag. She completed her appearance with a braided hairstyle, smoky eye makeup and dewy skin. Her choice of accessories added further detail to the traditional ensemble.Shilpa Shetty arrived in a pink saree paired with a contrasting green blouse. Mira Rajput chose a champagne-gold saree for the celebration, keeping her look elegant and traditional. The guests brought different styles to the gathering, with colourful outfits and jewellery adding to the festive atmosphere. Anshula Kapoor also had a special reason to celebrate this year. The actor Arjun Kapoor's sister marked her first Karwa Chauth after marrying Rohan Thakkar earlier this year.Aamir Khan's recent film projectsOn the professional front, Aamir Khan's most recent major lead role was in 'Sitaare Zameen Par'.
